context: A couple sits down to file taxes and forms together
purpose: Teach: 利子/就労/運輸/納め/間隔/有益/問合せ/外観

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今年の確定申告、ちゃんと税金を納めないとね。書類の問合せ先ってどこだっけ？
lines.en: We have to properly pay our taxes for this year's return. Where's the contact for inquiries again?
lines.style: Wife organizing tax paperwork, slightly worried but composed tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 市役所の窓口だよ。建物の外観が新しくなったから、すぐ分かると思う。
lines.en: It's at the city hall counter. The building's exterior was renovated, so you'll spot it easily.
lines.style: Husband reassuring, matter-of-fact and helpful explanation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そういえば、銀行預金の利子も申告するの？少しだけど。
lines.en: By the way, do we have to declare the interest from our bank deposits too? It's only a little.
lines.style: Wife asking practical question, mildly uncertain about the rules.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、必要だよ。あと、君のパート先の就労証明書も添付しないといけない。
lines.en: Yeah, that's required. Also we need to attach the employment certificate from your part-time job.
lines.style: Husband explaining carefully, slightly serious tax-filing voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 面倒だなぁ。書類を出す間隔って、毎年こんなに短かったっけ？
lines.en: What a hassle. Was the interval between filing deadlines always this short every year?
lines.style: Wife sighing in mild exasperation, half-joking complaint.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 去年と同じだよ。あ、僕の運輸会社からの源泉徴収票、ここに入れておくね。
lines.en: Same as last year. Oh, I'll put my withholding slip from the transport company right here.
lines.style: Husband calmly organizing documents into proper piles.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 国税庁のサイト、結構有益な情報が載ってたよ。控除のところとか。
lines.en: The National Tax Agency website actually had useful information, especially about deductions.
lines.style: Wife sharing helpful discovery, mildly impressed tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ほんと？じゃあ今度から先にそこ見よう。終わったらコーヒーでも飲もうか。
lines.en: Really? Then let's check there first from now on. Shall we grab some coffee once we're done?
lines.style: Husband warmly suggesting a small reward together.
